source_claim: Three distinct Navel-published SHUFFLE! routes were checked for Tsuchimi Rin. The official materials confirm the game and name many associated characters, but the accessible checked material did not explicitly identify Rin.

checked_routes.result: The official SHUFFLE! site provides game wallpapers and labels several character images, but the accessible page text does not name Tsuchimi Rin.
Official goods descriptions name the main heroines and several subcharacters as SHUFFLE! characters; the checked text does not identify Tsuchimi Rin.
The official page establishes the SHUFFLE! console game and names Kareha, Mayumi, Tsubomi, Lisianthus, and Nerine, but does not name Tsuchimi Rin.

notes: Partial progress only. Preserve the seven positive SHUFFLE! HOME relations in companion AUTHORITY_BATCH files. No negative relation or terminal conclusion is asserted for Tsuchimi Rin.
